item.title: Not every garnet is a red stone
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Garnet is a family of gem minerals with many colors, including orange and green varieties.
EXIMUTC view: Identify the variety before comparing two garnets' prices.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/garnet-description
